notes: The supplied 'is' was given to χάρισμα as the only nominal left in its verbless clause, the article keeping only its own 'the' (rules 53, 63 and 96); attaching it to οὕτως remains defensible but the adverb there is the correlative, not the predicate, and the note records the competing reading.
χάρισμα → 'free gift' heads on 'gift', which glosses the lexeme, 'free' being the supplied modifier (rule 66) — the same reading as 5:16.

ἐν χάριτι τῇ τοῦ ἑνὸς ἀνθρώπου: τῇ follows its anarthrous noun, so the supplied determiner stays on χάριτι (rule 31), and since the ASV supplies no relative clause the postposed article is `unrepresented`.
